ValidationRule.description: Para perder una oportunidad, es necesario pasar por el estado Ready to close
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( opportunity_expiration_ind_type__c = false, OR(RecordType.DeveloperName='Business_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName='Draft_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Confidential_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName='Privileged_Opportunity'), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Proposal'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Approval')), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost'), ISCHANGED(StageName) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In order to close the opportunity, please go to the stage 'Ready to close'.
